content.title: Stephanie McMahon, AJ Styles, and more immortalized into the WWE Hall of Fame: Class of 2026
content.text: Stephanie McMahon, AJ Styles, and more immortalized into the WWE Hall of Fame: Class of 2026 Stephanie McMahon was inducted into the WWE Hall of Fame by her mother Linda McMahon and her three daughters Aurora, Murphy, and Vaughn Levesque. During her induction speech for the WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2026, Stephanie McMahon reflects on her relationship with Paul “Triple H” Levesque and the support of the WWE family who grew up alongside her in the sports-entertainment industry. At the conclusion of her WWE Hall of Fame induction speech, Stephanie McMahon throws it back to her beginnings and invokes her past as one of sports-entertainment’s great villains to sum up her place in WWE immortality. Ax and Smash a.k.a. Demolition were inducted into the WWE Hall of Fame by Haku, The Warlord, and WWE Hall of Famer Arn Anderson. Ax & Smash recognize the WWE icons who helped them reach their potential as one of WWE’s greatest tag teams ever. Dennis Rodman was inducted into the Celebrity Wing of the WWE Hall of Fame by fellow N.W.O. members Kevin Nash and Sean Waltman. WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2026 Celebrity inductee Dennis Rodman honors his long-time friend Hulk Hogan and stays true to his NWO roots in his speech. Hulk Hogan vs. André the Giant at WrestleMania III was recognized as the 2026 Immortal Moment by WWE Hall of Famer Jimmy Hart, Hogan's son Nick, and Andre's daughter, Robin Christensen-Roussimoff. The legendary WrestleMania III clash altered sports-entertainment history forever, and now Hulk Hogan and Andre The Giant’s historic showdown is honored with the WWE Immortal Moment Award at the WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2026. AJ Styles was inducted into the WWE Hall of Fame by "The Good Brothers", Karl Anderson and Luke Gallows. AJ Styles extends his gratitude to those who helped him throughout his iconic wrestling career and exits the stage as a member of the WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2026. Legacy InducteesBad News Brown and Sid Vicious were posthumously inducted into the WWE Hall of Fame with the families in attendance. Featured Superstars
